content: Tsenakeriwi Kerutsareme kemɨtiuta'uni
Tamamata heimana nauka wiyari ti'aitakaku 'Etsekiyaxi, Tsenakeriwi 'Atsiriya kwieyaritsie ti'aitame, Kura kaniutamieni meta kiekariteya mɨtɨrɨkawi yuhetsiemieme kanayeitɨani.

Ti'aitame 'Atsiriya kiekame Rakixi paitɨ 'ukaitɨ kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame kanenɨ'ani, yumɨireme kuyaxi warawitɨkɨme, ti'aitame 'Etsekiyaxi hamatɨa mɨretaxatakɨ Kerutsareme paitɨ. Kepauka kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame, haa wapaitɨ meukatuarike manuhuyeritɨarie manuyekatsie mu'uxipi, 'Ekwame Kwieya makuma huyeyari manuyehane 'utɨa,
hikɨ kanayeyani 'enunakeke 'Eriyakini paratsiyuta mɨti'aitakai Kirikiyaxi nu'aya, warawitɨtɨ kemɨtiuyɨ ti'utɨwa Tsewina meta ti'utɨwame Kuha 'Atsahapi nu'aya.
Kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame manuyeka mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: ―Mɨpaɨ xeketenetahɨawi 'Etsekiyaxi kename mɨpaɨ haine ti'aitame mɨmariwe, ti'aitame 'Atsiriya kiekame: “¿Ketitatsie peti'atɨrɨkariya?
'Ekɨ mɨpaɨ pemutaine kename perakumate meta kename kuyaxi pewarexeiya, peru neuxei mɨkɨ pɨniuki xeikɨa. ¿Ketitatsie petiwiya, titayari peti'awaɨriya penetsi'aye'unietɨ pemayanikɨ?

Neuxei, 'ekɨ 'Ekipitutsie pemɨtiwiya, mɨkɨ 'itsɨ mɨxainitsie, xɨka hetsiena perawiya manumure meta mɨtiwakwinitɨa kemɨ'ane mana memɨtehawiwiya. Mɨkɨ Parahuni kanihɨkɨtɨni ti'aitame 'Ekipitu kiekame, kemɨ'ane hetsiena memɨtewiya wahetsiemieme.

Xɨka 'ekɨ mɨpaɨ penetiutahɨawe: ‘Tame Yawé hetsie tepɨtewiya takakaɨyaritsie’, ¿kamɨtsɨ mɨkɨ katixatsiwa, 'Etsekiyaxi, 'iya hakewa Kakaɨyari hetsiemieme mawari matiwewiwatɨkateitsie meta tukite 'etsimupepe pemuti'unaxɨ, mɨpaɨ petiwakɨhɨawetɨ Kuratsie kiekatari meta Kerutsaremetari: ‘'Ikɨ mawari taiyame hɨxie xeikɨa kaniyɨwemɨkɨ xemeyexeiyanikɨ’?”
»Hikɨ 'Etsekiyaxi, 'ikɨ tɨratu keneuwewi neti'aitɨwame hamatɨa, ti'aitame 'Atsiriya kiekame: Ne nepɨmatsiyetuirie huta miriyari kawayutsixi, xɨkata 'ekɨ mɨpaɨ yupaɨmeme pewakuwaumɨkɨ memanutiyaxe.
'Ekɨ pepɨkayɨwe xeime tɨma pemutaweiyakɨ tsepa waɨkawa mɨkayɨwe neti'aitɨwame hetsɨa miemete, tsepa 'Ekipitu hetsie pemuyɨkɨ'ɨ kaxetate yumemiwame mexeiyakɨ meta kawayatsixi.
¿Kamɨtsɨ xeme mɨpaɨ xɨari xepɨteku'eriwa kename ne Yawé kanetsiparewiekaku neyɨane 'ikɨ kiekari nemu'unamɨkɨ? Matsi mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ kanetineta'aitɨani: “Mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie kenemieka keneka'una”».

'Eriyakini hamatɨa Tsewina meta Kuha mɨpaɨ kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwa mekateniutahɨawe: ―Neuxei pamɨpariyutsixɨa, tame temate'uximayatsiriwamete 'arameu niukiyarikɨ ketatinekuxaxatɨwani tame mɨkɨ tekani'enieka. Hepɨrayukɨ pepɨkatatsikɨhɨaweni, yunaitɨ kurarutsie memakatei mepɨta'enana.

Peru kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Ne neti'aitɨwame pɨkanetsiheyenɨ'a 'ekɨ meta mati'aitɨwame hamatɨa xeikɨa nemɨtixetaxatɨanikɨ, matsita kurarutsie memakatei yunaime. Metsɨ yunaitɨ mɨkɨ meta xeme yukwita xekanitikwaikuni meta yuxixi xekanitiharikuni.
Mɨpaɨ 'utayɨka, kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame 'akaniutakeni, hikɨ kwi 'utahiwatɨ hepɨrayukɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Ti'aitame mumariwe niukieya xekeneu'eni, ti'aitame 'Atsiriya kiekame:
Mɨpaɨ kainaneni ti'aitame: “'Etsekiyaxi nɨka tixe'u'itaiya. Mɨkɨ mɨxe'utawikweitsitɨani pɨkayɨwe.
'Etsekiyaxi xepɨka'enieka mɨxekemakaxɨanikɨ Yawé hetsie yuri xemɨte'eriekakɨ mɨpaɨ xetikɨhɨawetɨ: ‘Yurikɨ Yawé pɨtatsixɨna, 'ikɨ kiekari 'Atsiriyatsie ti'aitame hetsɨa pɨkakaweni.’”

»'Etsekiyaxi xepɨka'enieka. Mɨpaɨ kanaineni ti'aitame 'Atsiriya kiekame: “Nehamatɨa kayuwatɨ xemexeiyanikɨ tɨratu xekeneuwewi, xekeneyuyetua. Mɨpaɨ xɨka xe'ɨyɨni xepɨtetikwani yukaxietsie timieme meta yupiní 'ikwaxiyari, metatsiere xepɨtihareni yuputsuta,
kepaukaketa ne nemayeneni nemɨxe'anuwitɨni xekwie hepaɨ 'anemetsie, kwie tɨriku maxuawetsie meta kaxie winuyari, paa maxuawetsie meta kaxie harawerita”.

»Xepɨka yuwaɨriyani xɨka 'Etsekiyaxi mɨpaɨ tixekɨhɨaweni: “Yawé tahetsie kanitanuamɨkɨ”. ¿Hipatɨ nuiwari kamɨtsɨ wakakaɨyarima wahetsie mete'utanua kepauka ti'aitame 'Atsiriya kiekame wahetsɨa mɨye'a?
¿Hakewa kamɨtsɨ Kamati kakaɨyarimama meta 'Axipari? ¿Hakewa kamɨtsɨ Tsepariwahini kakaɨyarimama? ¿Kamɨtsɨ Tsamariya tiutawikweitsitɨa 'Atsiriya hetsɨa?
Xewitɨtɨma kakaɨyaritɨtɨ 'ikɨ nuiwarite wakwieyaritsie 'uyeikatɨ pɨkayɨwe yukiekari mɨxɨnakɨ netɨrɨkariyatsie. ¿Kamɨtsɨ tiyɨweta Yawé Kerutsareme hetsie mutanuani kepauka nemika'una?»
Peru teɨteri kayuwatɨ mepumakai ni'etsiwatɨma mepɨka'utiniu, ti'aitame mɨpaɨ mainekaikɨ: «Xepɨka'iku'eiyani».

Hikɨ 'Eriyakini Kirikiyaxi nu'aya, mɨti'uximayakai paratsiyuta, meta Tsewina kemɨtiuyɨ ti'utɨwame metatsiere mɨraka'utɨwa Kuha 'Atsahapi nu'aya, yukamixa meheukatsanaxɨaka hiwerika 'inɨariyari memexeiyanikɨ, menekɨne 'Etsekiyaxi hetsɨa, mekatenitaxatɨani kemutayɨkai kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame.
